blurb: Clarks Fork of the Yellowstone: sections between Wyoming Game and Fish Department river access points.

sections.notes: Put-in Morrison Jeep Trail (Clarks Fork): approximate area only. Take-out River Runners (Clarks Fork): exact agency facility pin. Wyoming: next to private land the streambed is private — no anchoring, wading or getting out without landowner permission; floating through is legal. Watercraft entering Wyoming Mar 1–Nov 30 need an AIS inspection. Mileage: preliminary NHDPlus V2 routed geometry (2.7 mi); no agency mileage found.

putInAccess.sourceName: Wyoming Game and Fish Department — River Access Points (All_River_Access_Points/FeatureServer/0)
putInAccess.note: Boating access is documented by WGFD River Access Points OBJECTID 10 ('Morrison Jeep Trail', listed as a launch). The coordinate is BLM National Recreation Site Points (FeatureServer/2), OBJECTID 84125 'Clarks Fork Canyon Fishing Access Parking' (Parking Area), 23 m from the WGFD point; approximate area, not the exact launch. Why not exact: no agency boat-facility point within 100 m; coordinate is a nearby agency access/parking feature.
putInAccess.directions: Approximate area only: the Morrison Jeep Trail access listed by Wyoming Game and Fish, at or near the agency feature 'Clarks Fork Canyon Fishing Access Parking'. Locate the launch on site; stay on public ground — the streambed and banks next to private land are private.
